record.question: If 10% of students in 2023 dropped out, how many students remained enrolled that year?
record.explanation: The 2023 table entries total 180+200+160=540 students. Ten percent is 54; after those students drop out, 540−54=486 remain, option B. Verified worked solution; unofficial. No matching official answer key was found in the targeted source search on 24 October 2026.
record.direction: Direction (Questions 70–72): The table below shows the number of students enrolled in three courses (A, B, and C) in a coaching institute over five years.

A line graph represents the total number of students enrolled each year.
